value.rationale: A sharp complete ID/non-ID phase boundary is a meaningful structural invariant for an established overdispersed count model. It decides exactly whether representation by independent Poisson shocks is possible, gives its complete Lévy jump weights, and provides a finite exact obstruction in the excluded regime; strict log-concavity cannot make the distinction. No downstream empirical claims are needed or made.
